# Osama Sharaf (أسامة شرف), Full Stack Developer

> Osama Sharaf is a Full-Stack Engineer based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. He builds production websites, online stores and web apps with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Supabase and Firebase, with a focus on speed (95+ PageSpeed), technical SEO (100/100) and polished, scroll-driven interfaces. 15+ happy clients and 15+ projects delivered. Open to freelance work and to relocation worldwide.

## Projects

- [Milestone Store](https://osamasharaf.dev/project/milestone): A complete e-commerce platform for the Milestone kitchen-appliance brand: 250+ products, customer accounts, online ordering and a central admin dashboard. Live: https://milestone.website
- [Milestone Showroom](https://osamasharaf.dev/project/milestone-showroom): A single-screen showroom website for Milestone. Every scroll swaps the scene in place, and every scene arrives with its own transition. Live: https://milestonechannels.netlify.app
- [Digital Codes For Trading](https://osamasharaf.dev/project/digital-codes): The official website of Digital Codes For Trading: a five-page company profile with custom animations, interactive UI and a 95+ PageSpeed score. Live: https://digital-codes.co
- [OZE Chocolate](https://osamasharaf.dev/project/oze): A one-page scroll website for OZE, a premium Swiss chocolate shop in Riyadh, in English and Arabic, with signature flavours, occasions and WhatsApp ordering. Live: https://oze-chocolate.vercel.app
- [NOUÉ Chocolate Gifts](https://osamasharaf.dev/project/noue): A scroll-driven website for a chocolate gift house in Riyadh. One golden ribbon runs from the knot in the logo to the bow in the footer. Live: https://noue-chocolate.vercel.app
- [GHURZA Couture](https://osamasharaf.dev/project/ghurza): An Arabic website for a Riyadh couture house, designed as a fashion magazine you browse by scrolling, with an interactive dress gallery. Live: https://ghurza.vercel.app
- [GD Graphic Design](https://osamasharaf.dev/project/gd-studio): A one-page, scroll-driven website for a graphic design studio in Riyadh. Each service has its own scene, and every scene opens with its own transition. Live: https://gd-graphic-design-company.vercel.app
- [AZM Studio](https://osamasharaf.dev/project/azm): A cinematic, scroll-driven website for an architecture and interior design studio: the visitor walks from the street, through the door and into the house. Live: https://azm-builds.vercel.app
- [Reem Sharaf Portfolio](https://osamasharaf.dev/project/reem-sharaf): A cinematic one-page portfolio for Eng. Reem Sharaf, software engineer, AI researcher and lecturer. Sections swap in place, each with its own transition. Live: https://reemsharaf.vercel.app
